profile.headline: Software Engineer at Clearwater Analytics
profile.summary:
Make things better every day. 

I have years of experience as a project manager, process manager, people manager, a BS in Computer Science from Boise State University, and a BA in Geography from George Mason University. Currently I am working as a software engineer at Clearwater Analytics in Boise, ID.

My primary interests are in web-based software applications, working on improving or implementing new solutions for providing users the information they need.  I prefer working in a organization that understands the need for a cross-functional and non-hierarchical approach to problem solving and project management.

Specialties: Spacial data collection, web development, people management, project management, process flows, and communications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop financial analysis software (SaSS) for web-based investment portfolio accounting, reporting, and reconciliation services for institutional investors
* Work in an Agile development environment
* Extensive work in Java and SQL
* Significant work in modeling fund-based products

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Developed web-based business solutions in a LAMP environment
* Worked directly with clients to understand and develop software based on customer needs
* Worked in a  Scrum software development environment with a strong customer focus
* Extensive work in PHP and SQL

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
* Managed project that measured the accuracy of transportation routing network for digital map products in the US, Canada, and Mexico
* Estimated and monitored project scopes and submit projected quarterly/annual budgets for an approximately 12,000 man-hour project conducted in approximate 45 varied locations annually
* Worked with Product Marketing, Quality, and Field teams to define testing processes, procedures, and schedules
* Lead "root cause analysis" efforts to determine process issues and corrective actions needed to address map data quality concerns

positions.title: Manager Pacific Northwest Field Offices
positions.description:
* Managed Nokia Maps field employees and projects for expanding and enhancing transportation network maps (GIS) for the Seattle, Portland, Boise offices
* Created resource budgets (manpower and monetary expenditures) for projects; monitored progress, and adhered to budgets
* Provided leadership and mentoring to 6-10 direct reports

positions.title: Geographic Analyst
positions.description:
* Maintained transportation network map database (GIS) in Idaho and Montana
* Maintained the NAVTEQ geographic database using GPS and database software tools
* Performed UAT testing for new software releases
* Lead new-hire training classes for international employees

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
*  Developed and maintained web pages on Sun's external web site using HTML, CSS, Perl, and XML
* Represented customer's perspective on cross-functional teams goaled with increasing customer satisfaction rates for product downloads
* redesigned and implemented company-wide sales intranet site for all software products excluding Solaris and Java

positions.title: Quality Asurance Manager
positions.description:
*  Managed the Quality Assurance department for North American operations
* Worked inter-departmentally in establishing quality goals and objectives
* Developed departmental intranet site to communicate goals, and to store/archive process results and documentation
* Represented company and company's interest at international ISO and national ANSI standards meetings

positions.title: Quality Specialist / Digital Cartographer
positions.description:
* Performed database audits to ensure that quality objectives were met
* Wrote process documentation and technical manuals
* Developed new company-wide process for measuring geographical data accuracy compared to real-world
* Created a large scale relational database and user interface to track quality measurements
* Maintained and expanded high quality geographical database suitable for vehicle navigation using internally developed mapping program and ARC/Info to capture geographic information from aerial imagery and map sources
* Twice recognized with company-wide award for implementing programs benefiting the company

positions.title: Digital Cartographer
positions.description:
*  Maintained database of aeronautical information used for in-flight applications and aeronautical chart production
* Coordinated with government agencies and private sector companies to ensure the accuracy of published aeronautical information
* Developed automated solution for converting database geographic point datum from NAD27 to WGS84

positions.title: Cartographer
positions.description:
* Interpreted high altitude photography, USGS quadrangles, and other map sources for selecting sampling units used to produce a national crop survey
* Managed workflow of a team of geographers and coordinated team projects to ensure timely completion and adherence to deadlines
* Ensured that statistical standards were maintained in the selection of sampling units

educations.fieldOfStudy: Geography with an emphasis on Urban Studies and Planning
